name: Extruded heat sinks
short: A practical foundation for everyday thermal challenges.
description: Aluminum extrusion provides a cost-conscious starting point for air-cooled thermal designs. ITS develops the geometry, mounting features and finishing around the requirements of your assembly.
considerations: Airflow, fin geometry, mounting envelope and cost

name: Skived fin heat sinks
short: Dense fin structures for compact cooling designs.
description: Skiving forms thin fins from a single block of aluminum or copper. ITS evaluates fin density and spacing together with the airflow and heat source layout to develop the design.
construction: Fins formed from the base material
considerations: Fin spacing, pressure drop and thermal load

name: Embedded heat pipes
short: Move heat away from concentrated hot spots.
description: Heat pipes integrated into a heat sink help spread heat across the base. ITS uses this approach when concentrated heat sources make conventional heat sinks difficult to optimize.
material: Aluminum heat sink with copper heat pipes
construction: Heat pipes integrated into the heat sink
application: RF amplifiers and concentrated heat sources
considerations: Heat source placement, orientation and integration

name: Bonded Heat Sink
short: High-aspect-ratio bonded fin assemblies for high-power thermal spreading.
description: Grooved base plates with mechanically bonded or epoxied individual fins, enabling fin height-to-gap ratios exceeding 30:1 for high volumetric cooling.
construction: High-precision slotting with thermally conductive bonding matrix
application: High-power motor drives, IGBT inverters and power conversion cabinets
considerations: Fin pitch, base flatness and thermal interface pressure

name: HyperCool cold plates
short: Custom flow paths. Precision thermal management.
description: Machined or friction stir welded fluid passages direct coolant where it is needed most. ITS designs the flow layout to balance thermal performance with pressure drop across the operating range.
construction: Friction stir welded or vacuum brazed assembly
application: High-density power electronics and motor drives
considerations: Flow rate, pressure drop and fluid compatibility

name: Copper Embedded Cold Plate
short: An economical route to liquid cooling.
description: Continuous copper tubing pressed or epoxied into a machined aluminum base plate, eliminating fluid-to-aluminum contact while offering high heat extraction.
material: Aluminum base with seamless copper tubing (C12200)
construction: CNC channel milling with mechanical expansion embedding
application: Laser diodes, power supplies and medical electronics
considerations: Tube bend radii, surface contact flatness and pressure proofing

name: Laminated Bus Bar
short: Integrated bus bar assemblies & sealed channels for demanding cooling.
description: Multi-layer laminated busbar structures with integrated liquid cooling channels and dielectric insulation, designed to minimize stray inductance in high-speed switching power systems.
material: High-conductivity ETP Copper (C11000) & Mylar / Kapton dielectric insulation
construction: Precision laser cut, laminated multilayer assembly with edge sealing
application: EV inverters, renewable energy power conversion, and battery management systems
considerations: Partial discharge resistance, dielectric withstand voltage, and inductance optimization

name: Copper Bus Bar
short: High-purity machined copper conductors for heavy industrial currents.
description: Custom CNC-machined and formed copper busbars with tin, nickel, or silver plating for corrosion protection and low contact resistance.
material: Electrolytic Tough Pitch (ETP) Copper C11000 or Oxygen-Free C10200
construction: CNC machining, bending, punch-forming, and electroplating
application: Switchgear, data center power delivery, battery racks, and industrial transformers
considerations: Ampacity requirements, temperature rise, plating thickness, and isolation distances
